structure_map.boundary_assessment: Strict downward dependency flow from Tier 5 (App/Factories) -> Tier 4 (Middleware/Error) -> Tier 3 (Routing) -> Tier 2 (CallableResolver/Psr17) -> Tier 1 (Interfaces/Exceptions). Only a single 2-node cross-layer reference exists where Slim\Interfaces\DispatcherInterface references concrete Slim\Routing\RoutingResults.

execution_flows.name: 1. Zero-Configuration PSR-17 Auto-Discovery & App Bootstrap
execution_flows.trigger: Invocation of AppFactory::create() or AppFactory::createFromContainer($container) during application initialization
steps: AppFactory::determineResponseFactory() iterates through Psr17FactoryProvider::$factories (SlimPsr17Factory, NyholmPsr17Factory, GuzzlePsr17Factory, LaminasDiactorosPsr17Factory, HttpSoftPsr17Factory) until it finds an installed PSR-17 ResponseFactoryInterface.
AppFactory constructs CallableResolver, RouteCollector (defaulting to RequestResponse invocation strategy), RouteResolver, RouteRunner, and MiddlewareDispatcher seeded with RouteRunner.

User code registers routes ($app->get, $app->post, $app->group) on RouteCollectorProxy and pushes PSR-15 middlewares ($app->add, $app->addBodyParsingMiddleware, $app->addRoutingMiddleware, $app->addErrorMiddleware) onto MiddlewareDispatcher's LIFO stack.

execution_flows.name: 2. Concentric PSR-15 Middleware Execution, FastRoute Matching & Route Invocation
steps: When $request is null in App::run(), ServerRequestCreatorFactory::create()->createServerRequestFromGlobals() synthesizes an immutable PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface from PHP superglobals.
MiddlewareDispatcher::handle($request) traverses the LIFO middleware onion from outermost (typically ErrorMiddleware) inward through RoutingMiddleware and BodyParsingMiddleware.

RoutingMiddleware::performRouting() invokes RouteResolver::computeRoutingResults() -> Dispatcher -> FastRouteDispatcher, attaching RouteContext::ROUTE, ROUTE_PARSER, and ROUTING_RESULTS attributes to $request (or throwing HttpNotFoundException / HttpMethodNotAllowedException).

At the center of the application middleware stack, RouteRunner::handle() resolves RouteGroup middlewares and delegates to Route::run(), which executes route-specific middlewares before invoking the matched callable via RequestHandlerInvocationStrategyInterface (RequestResponse, RequestResponseArgs, or RequestResponseNamedArgs).
In App::run(), ResponseEmitter::emit($response) sends status line, HTTP headers, and chunked body stream bytes to the PHP output buffer.

execution_flows.name: 3. Exception Interception & Content-Negotiated Error Rendering
execution_flows.trigger: Any Throwable (such as HttpNotFoundException, HttpMethodNotAllowedException, or domain exception) thrown inside the middleware or route pipeline
steps: ErrorMiddleware::process() catches Throwable inside its try/catch boundary and invokes ErrorMiddleware::handleException($request, $exception).
ErrorMiddleware looks up a registered exact-match or subclass-match handler in $this->handlers, falling back to the default ErrorHandler.

ErrorHandler::__invoke() determines the HTTP status code (e.g. 404/405 from HttpException or 500 for generic Throwable), logs the error via PSR-3 LoggerInterface when $logErrors is enabled, and inspects the request Accept header via determineRenderer().

The selected ErrorRendererInterface (JsonErrorRenderer, XmlErrorRenderer, HtmlErrorRenderer, or PlainTextErrorRenderer) serializes the error payload into a new PSR-7 ResponseInterface with CORS/Allow headers preserved.

state_and_storage: In-Memory Route & Middleware Topology: RouteCollector holds registered Route and RouteGroup objects; MiddlewareDispatcher holds the wrapped RequestHandlerInterface chain in memory.
Optional FastRoute Regex Cache File: RouteCollector::$cacheFile persists compiled FastRoute dispatch tables to disk via var_export() when configured in production.

Immutable Per-Request Context State: Routing state (__route__, __routeParser__, __routingResults__, __basePath__) and parsed bodies are carried immutably on PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface attributes rather than mutable globals.
execution_flow_map.error_and_concurrency_model: Shared-nothing synchronous PHP SAPI model (PHP-FPM / CLIServer) plus long-running worker compatibility (RoadRunner, Swoole, FrankenPHP) enabled by immutable PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface / ResponseInterface value objects and stateless PSR-15 RequestHandlerInterface::handle() execution. Errors propagate as typed HttpSpecializedException subclasses (400–501) or general Throwables caught by ErrorMiddleware.

audit_dimensions.title: Interpret PHP AST Facts & Evaluate Quality, Strict Types, Sinks & Frameworks
audit_dimensions.summary: Slim Framework v4.15.3 (72 source files, 3,149 LOC, 72 classes/interfaces, 311 callables) demonstrates a remarkably compact, high-cohesion micro-framework architecture built around PSR-7, PSR-11, PSR-15, and PSR-17 contracts. Every single source file declares declare(strict_types=1), 98.6% of files maintain strict PSR-12 import ordering, and SAST analysis confirms zero dangerous CWE sinks (0 SQLi, 0 XSS, 0 command/file injection) and zero direct superglobal reads in core routing/middleware classes. Minor architectural findings include a 2-node cycle between Slim\Interfaces\DispatcherInterface and concrete Slim\Routing\RoutingResults, cognitive complexity hotspots in MiddlewareDispatcher::addDeferred (cognitive=26 due to inline anonymous RequestHandlerInterface class resolution), a 9-parameter constructor in Slim\Routing\Route, and 62 mixed/polymorphic callable parameters intentionally left untyped at the signature level to preserve PHP 7.4 compatibility prior to PHP 8.0 union types.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Public API Boundaries, Import Purity, SemVer & Diátaxis Docs
audit_dimensions.summary: Slim Framework v4.15.3 exemplifies PSR reusable library design (`common/library_guidelines`). It exposes 17 explicit interfaces under `Slim\Interfaces\`, has zero import-time side effects, zero `exit`/`die` statements in library code, flexible SemVer caret (`^`) and union (`||`) bounds on all 7 runtime dependencies (`psr/container: ^1.0 || ^2.0`, `psr/http-message: ^1.1 || ^2.0`, `psr/log: ^1.1 || ^2.0 || ^3.0`), and zero scattered `getenv()`/`$_ENV` reads.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate PHP Test Suite Completeness & Structure
audit_dimensions.summary: Slim Framework v4.15.3 maintains a rigorous, well-structured PHPUnit test suite comprising 35 test classes and 306 test methods under `tests/` mirroring the `Slim/` namespace tree (`Factory/`, `Handlers/`, `Middleware/`, `Routing/`, `Error/`, `Exception/`). All tests run 100% offline using in-memory PSR-7 mocks (`PSR7ObjectProvider`), `AdrianSuter\Autoload\Override` for deterministic `header()`/`connection_status()`/`is_writable()` SAPI interception, and Prophecy spies (`phpspec/prophecy-phpunit`).

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate PHP Packaging, Composer Lockfile, Runtime Version & Governance
audit_dimensions.summary: Slim Framework v4.15.3 exhibits exemplary Composer packaging and PSR-4 supply-chain hygiene. All 7 runtime dependencies are strictly bounded to stable PSR interfaces (psr/http-message, psr/http-server-handler, psr/http-server-middleware, psr/http-factory, psr/container, psr/log) plus nikic/fast-route (^1.3), with zero unpinned dependencies, a deterministic composer.lock (93 locked packages), full static analysis coverage (PHPStan, Psalm, PHP_CodeSniffer PSR-12), and complete governance documentation (README.md, CHANGELOG.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, SECURITY.md, LICENSE-SLIM).

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Buildability, Offline Test Results, Measured Coverage & Startup Health
audit_dimensions.summary: Containerized runtime verification (`php:8.2-cli-bookworm` + Composer 2 + PCOV 1.0.12) succeeded across all 4 stages (`RV-01` through `RV-04`). The hermetic container image built cleanly (`exit_code=0`), all 72 source files passed `php -l` syntax checks, the offline (`--network=none`) PHPUnit 11.5.57 suite passed 100% of test cases (`0` failures, `0` errors, `0` warnings, 846 assertions across 441 tests), PCOV Clover measured **99.4% line coverage** (1,049 / 1,055 statements covered; 13 of 15 core modules at 100.0% coverage), and the Composer PSR-4 autoloader smoke check passed (`exit_code=0`).

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Supply-Chain CVEs, Container Misconfigs, Secrets, Dangerous Sinks & API Boundaries
audit_dimensions.summary: Trivy supply-chain, secret, and container security scanning combined with PHP SAST analysis confirms a 100% clean security posture for Slim Framework v4.15.3. Zero CVEs were detected across all 93 locked Composer packages (`core_app_vuln_counts.total = 0`, `dev_app_vuln_counts.total = 0`), zero hardcoded or committed secrets exist (`secrets = []`), zero container misconfigurations exist (`misconfigurations = []`), and AST analysis found zero dangerous sinks (`dangerous_sinks = []`). Note: `harness_os_vuln_counts` reflects Debian Bookworm OS packages inside the ephemeral `.pni/dockerfiles/Dockerfile` test harness, which are properly isolated from library scoring (`os_vuln_counts.total = 0`).

findings.description: MiddlewareDispatcher::addDeferred (101 lines, cognitive=26) embeds an inline anonymous RequestHandlerInterface class (68 lines, cognitive=26) that catches and ignores RuntimeException at line 186 when falling back from CallableResolverInterface::resolve() to custom PSR-15 resolution.
findings.recommendation: Extract the deferred middleware resolution anonymous class into a dedicated private helper method or internal DeferredMiddlewareHandler class and prefer AdvancedCallableResolverInterface::resolveMiddleware().

findings.description: Slim\Interfaces\DispatcherInterface imports and returns concrete Slim\Routing\RoutingResults, while Slim\Routing\RoutingResults imports Slim\Interfaces\DispatcherInterface in its constructor, forming a 2-node interface-to-implementation cycle.
findings.recommendation: Extract a RoutingResultsInterface under Slim\Interfaces\ or move result status constants onto DispatcherInterface to keep Slim\Interfaces\ strictly leaf-level.

findings.description: Slim\CallableResolver declares 'public static $callablePattern = ...' as a mutable public static property rather than a class constant.
findings.recommendation: Convert CallableResolver::$callablePattern to a public or protected class constant (public const CALLABLE_PATTERN) and allow pattern customization via constructor injection.

findings.description: Public methods in Slim\Error\Renderers\*ErrorRenderer and getter/setter methods in Slim\Exception\HttpException omit explicit /** ... */ docblocks or @inheritdoc annotations (71.6% PHPDoc coverage).
findings.recommendation: Add @inheritdoc or concise PHPDoc blocks on public ErrorRenderer::__invoke implementations and HttpException accessors.

findings.description: Slim\Routing\Route::__construct accepts 9 positional parameters ($methods, $pattern, $callable, $responseFactory, $callableResolver, $container, $invocationStrategy, $groups, $identifier), exceeding the SIG 6-parameter threshold.
findings.recommendation: Group shared runtime collaborators ($responseFactory, $callableResolver, $container, $invocationStrategy) into an immutable RouteConfiguration value object in future major releases.

findings.description: composer.json require.php retains '~7.4.0 || ~8.0.0 || ~8.1.0' alongside '~8.2.0 || ~8.3.0 || ~8.4.0 || ~8.5.0' for broad ecosystem compatibility, preventing use of PHP 8.1+ readonly properties or native union types in core classes.
findings.recommendation: Maintain the 4.x compatibility floor for existing consumers while targeting PHP 8.2+ minimum bounds in the next major release (Slim 5.x).

findings.description: PCOV Clover coverage reports 99.4% overall coverage, leaving only Slim\Logger::log() line 30 (0/1 statements) and 5 edge-case lines in Slim\Routing\RouteCollector (69/74 statements, 93.2%) uncovered.
findings.recommendation: Add a dedicated unit test in tests/ exercising Slim\Logger::log() with an overridden error_log() stub.

findings.description: 20 test methods (such as AppTest::testDoesNotUseContainerAsServiceLocator and ErrorMiddlewareTest::testSetErrorHandler) verify behavior exclusively via Prophecy spy predictions ($prophecy->shouldBeCalled() / shouldNotBeCalled()) without an explicit PHPUnit $this->assert* call.
findings.recommendation: Keep Prophecy predictions paired with explicit return-value or state assertions where applicable to guard against vacuous spy configurations.

findings.description: 62 methods (including App::add, CallableResolver::resolve*, MiddlewareDispatcher::add, and RouteCollectorProxy::get/post) omit native parameter types on $middleware and $toResolve because union types (MiddlewareInterface|callable|string) require PHP 8.0+.
findings.recommendation: Adopt native PHP 8.0+ union types (MiddlewareInterface|callable|string and callable|array|string) once PHP 7.4 support is dropped.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: MiddlewareDispatcher::addDeferred (101 lines, cognitive=26) embeds an inline anonymous RequestHandlerInterface class (68 lines, cognitive=26) that catches and ignores RuntimeException at line 186 when falling back from CallableResolverInterface::resolve() to custom PSR-15 resolution.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: MiddlewareDispatcher::addDeferred (101 lines, cognitive=26) embeds an inline anonymous RequestHandlerInterface class (68 lines, cognitive=26) that catches and ignores RuntimeException at line 186 when falling back from CallableResolverInterface::resolve() to custom PSR-15 resolution.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Extract the deferred middleware resolution anonymous class into a dedicated private helper method or internal DeferredMiddlewareHandler class and prefer AdvancedCallableResolverInterface::resolveMiddleware().

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Slim\Interfaces\DispatcherInterface imports and returns concrete Slim\Routing\RoutingResults, while Slim\Routing\RoutingResults imports Slim\Interfaces\DispatcherInterface in its constructor, forming a 2-node interface-to-implementation cycle.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: Slim\Interfaces\DispatcherInterface imports and returns concrete Slim\Routing\RoutingResults, while Slim\Routing\RoutingResults imports Slim\Interfaces\DispatcherInterface in its constructor, forming a 2-node interface-to-implementation cycle.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Extract a RoutingResultsInterface under Slim\Interfaces\ or move result status constants onto DispatcherInterface to keep Slim\Interfaces\ strictly leaf-level.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Public methods in Slim\Error\Renderers\*ErrorRenderer and getter/setter methods in Slim\Exception\HttpException omit explicit /** ... */ docblocks or @inheritdoc annotations (71.6% PHPDoc coverage).
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: Public methods in Slim\Error\Renderers\*ErrorRenderer and getter/setter methods in Slim\Exception\HttpException omit explicit /** ... */ docblocks or @inheritdoc annotations (71.6% PHPDoc coverage).
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Add @inheritdoc or concise PHPDoc blocks on public ErrorRenderer::__invoke implementations and HttpException accessors.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: PCOV Clover coverage reports 99.4% overall coverage, leaving only Slim\Logger::log() line 30 (0/1 statements) and 5 edge-case lines in Slim\Routing\RouteCollector (69/74 statements, 93.2%) uncovered.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: PCOV Clover coverage reports 99.4% overall coverage, leaving only Slim\Logger::log() line 30 (0/1 statements) and 5 edge-case lines in Slim\Routing\RouteCollector (69/74 statements, 93.2%) uncovered.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Add a dedicated unit test in tests/ exercising Slim\Logger::log() with an overridden error_log() stub.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Slim\CallableResolver declares 'public static $callablePattern = ...' as a mutable public static property rather than a class constant.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: Slim\CallableResolver declares 'public static $callablePattern = ...' as a mutable public static property rather than a class constant.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Convert CallableResolver::$callablePattern to a public or protected class constant (public const CALLABLE_PATTERN) and allow pattern customization via constructor injection.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: composer.json require.php retains '~7.4.0 || ~8.0.0 || ~8.1.0' alongside '~8.2.0 || ~8.3.0 || ~8.4.0 || ~8.5.0' for broad ecosystem compatibility, preventing use of PHP 8.1+ readonly properties or native union types in core classes.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: composer.json require.php retains '~7.4.0 || ~8.0.0 || ~8.1.0' alongside '~8.2.0 || ~8.3.0 || ~8.4.0 || ~8.5.0' for broad ecosystem compatibility, preventing use of PHP 8.1+ readonly properties or native union types in core classes.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Maintain the 4.x compatibility floor for existing consumers while targeting PHP 8.2+ minimum bounds in the next major release (Slim 5.x).

consolidated_findings.primary_description: 62 methods (including App::add, CallableResolver::resolve*, MiddlewareDispatcher::add, and RouteCollectorProxy::get/post) omit native parameter types on $middleware and $toResolve because union types (MiddlewareInterface|callable|string) require PHP 8.0+.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: 62 methods (including App::add, CallableResolver::resolve*, MiddlewareDispatcher::add, and RouteCollectorProxy::get/post) omit native parameter types on $middleware and $toResolve because union types (MiddlewareInterface|callable|string) require PHP 8.0+.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Adopt native PHP 8.0+ union types (MiddlewareInterface|callable|string and callable|array|string) once PHP 7.4 support is dropped.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: 20 test methods (such as AppTest::testDoesNotUseContainerAsServiceLocator and ErrorMiddlewareTest::testSetErrorHandler) verify behavior exclusively via Prophecy spy predictions ($prophecy->shouldBeCalled() / shouldNotBeCalled()) without an explicit PHPUnit $this->assert* call.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: 20 test methods (such as AppTest::testDoesNotUseContainerAsServiceLocator and ErrorMiddlewareTest::testSetErrorHandler) verify behavior exclusively via Prophecy spy predictions ($prophecy->shouldBeCalled() / shouldNotBeCalled()) without an explicit PHPUnit $this->assert* call.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Keep Prophecy predictions paired with explicit return-value or state assertions where applicable to guard against vacuous spy configurations.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Slim\Routing\Route::__construct accepts 9 positional parameters ($methods, $pattern, $callable, $responseFactory, $callableResolver, $container, $invocationStrategy, $groups, $identifier), exceeding the SIG 6-parameter threshold.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: Slim\Routing\Route::__construct accepts 9 positional parameters ($methods, $pattern, $callable, $responseFactory, $callableResolver, $container, $invocationStrategy, $groups, $identifier), exceeding the SIG 6-parameter threshold.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Group shared runtime collaborators ($responseFactory, $callableResolver, $container, $invocationStrategy) into an immutable RouteConfiguration value object in future major releases.

action_plan.title: Refactor MiddlewareDispatcher::addDeferred inline anonymous handler into a dedicated helper class
action_plan.action: Extract the inline anonymous RequestHandlerInterface inside MiddlewareDispatcher::addDeferred into a dedicated internal class and eliminate the empty catch (RuntimeException) fallback block.
action_plan.expected_impact: Reduces cognitive complexity from 26 to <10 and clarifies PSR-15 middleware resolution error propagation.

action_plan.title: Decouple Slim\Interfaces\DispatcherInterface from concrete Slim\Routing\RoutingResults
action_plan.action: Introduce Slim\Interfaces\RoutingResultsInterface or relocate routing status constants so Slim\Interfaces\ has zero imports from Slim\Routing\.
action_plan.expected_impact: Eliminates the sole circular namespace dependency in the codebase.

action_plan.title: Add @inheritdoc or PHPDoc summaries to ErrorRenderer and HttpException public methods
action_plan.action: Annotate public methods in Slim\Error\Renderers\* and Slim\Exception\HttpException with @inheritdoc or explicit PHPDoc blocks.
action_plan.expected_impact: Increases AST PHPDoc coverage from 71.6% to >90%.

action_plan.title: Drop EOL PHP < 8.2 floor in next major version branch (Slim 5.x)
action_plan.action: Drop EOL PHP < 8.2 floor in next major version branch (Slim 5.x)
action_plan.expected_impact: Raising require.php to ^8.2 in Slim 5.x will unlock native readonly properties, constructor property promotion, and union/intersection type syntax across Slim core.

action_plan.title: Add unit test for Slim\Logger::log() fallback logger
action_plan.action: Create tests/LoggerTest.php verifying Slim\Logger::log() formatting and delegation.
action_plan.expected_impact: Raises measured PCOV line coverage from 99.4% to 99.5%+.

action_plan.action: Add explicit PHPUnit assertions alongside Prophecy shouldBeCalled() spy verifications in tests/AppTest.php and tests/Middleware/ErrorMiddlewareTest.php.
action_plan.expected_impact: Eliminates reliance on implicit Prophecy teardown checks alone.

action_plan.title: Add native union type hints to CallableResolver and MiddlewareDispatcher in next major release
action_plan.action: Replace PHPDoc-only @param callable|string|MiddlewareInterface annotations with native PHP 8.0+ union types when dropping PHP 7.4.
